verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets an LLM client work with its platform, and webhooks that push final payment outcomes. Together these give an agent some first-party programmatic access to transaction results. Payouts appear only as a setting for how you get paid. Nothing shows an API for retrieving transactions, payouts, or settlement reports, or the specific tools the MCP server exposes. Missing for 10: a documented transaction/payout retrieval or settlement-report API, MCP tool coverage for payments and payouts, reconciliation or ledger-export workflow, and hands-on corroboration.
